name: ArenaMenuItem
description: One entry in an ArenaMenu, in one of three shapes. An entry carrying `divider` draws a hairline rule, one carrying `header` draws a group label, and every other entry draws an activatable row. Every field is optional because no field is common to all three. There is no `id`, because a divider and a header have nothing to identify and `select` carries the whole item rather than a key into the list.

icon.description: A Phosphor class name drawn before the label -- Arena draws the <i>, the consumer names the glyph.

shortcut.description: The keyboard hint drawn right-aligned in the mono face. Display only: ArenaMenu binds no key for it.

destructive.description: Draws the row in the danger ink. Destructive entries go last.

disabled.description: The row is drawn muted and reports no `select`.

divider.description: Draws a hairline rule in place of a row. Carries no other field.

header.description: Draws a group label in place of a row. Carries no other field.
